name: Music Analyzer AI - Application Insights
description: Monitoring configuration for Azure Application Insights

queries.name: Request Rate
queries.query: requests | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m) | render timechart

queries.name: Error Rate
queries.query: requests | where success == false | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m) | render timechart

queries.name: Response Time
queries.query: requests | summarize avg(duration), percentile(duration, 50), percentile(duration, 95), percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 1m) | render timechart

queries.name: Top Errors
queries.query: exceptions | summarize count() by type | top 10 by count_ desc

queries.name: Dependencies
queries.query: dependencies | summarize count(), avg(duration) by target | top 10 by count_ desc

alerts.name: High Error Rate
alerts.condition: requests | where success == false | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m) | where count_ > 10

alerts.name: High Response Time
alerts.condition: requests | summarize avg(duration) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | where avg_duration > 5000
